about_the_game:
EoW: Willer's Dominion is a third person rogue-lite action game set within a fractured mind cursed by an ancient, malevolent force. Once a man with a forgotten past, you now fight through a corrupted world shaped by your fading memories. Every run is a brutal test of reflexes and strategy. Death is never the end, only a return. Unlock permanent upgrades, evolve your weapons, and survive against the all-seeing Eye that feeds on your will.

Your journey is defined by the choices you make. Choose your weapons and skills carefully before each run. Navigate through zones filled with traps, enemy waves, and powerful perks. Decide between safe paths or high-risk high-reward routes and build your ideal strategy as you go.

Master fast-paced melee combat with fluid combo chains, dodge cancels, and cinematic finisher executions. Exploit enemy weaknesses, use backstab mechanics for devastating critical hits, and choose from a range of active skills to customize your combat style. Each encounter demands precision and timing.

Power comes at a price. Equip Corrupted Items to gain devastating bonuses, but beware of stacking debuffs and the growing corruption that haunts you. Manage your risk carefully as the Eye watches, waiting for you to lose control. Survive the darkness or be consumed by it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: 2.5 Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580, GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: 3.0 Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT, Geforce RTX 2080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Willer's Dominion is a TPP rogue-lite action game where you unlock and upgrade weapons, master new skills, shape your build through powerful perks, and face the growing risk of corrupted items as you grow stronger with each run. Reclaim your will before the Eye’s curse consumes what’s left of you.
